summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` with the eleven specified members, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported EndpointResolverBuiltins; made `_should_set_global_sts_endpoint` accept an absent endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added public `compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults` at the end of ClientArgsCreator, which reuses the bridge's FIPS and DualStack lookups and the existing S3 and STS predicates and returns all eleven keys (SDK::Endpoint is None when absent), plus a private `_compute_sdk_endpoint` helper. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (unittest.TestCase base) with one test per behavioral criterion, including an S3 predicate call-count check. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 56 passed; test_regions.py, test_client.py, test_endpoint.py pass. tests/unit/test_session.py::test_internal_component fails, but it also fails on the unmodified code, so it predates this change. Nothing committed. Choices: SDK::Endpoint absent is represented as None; a None s3_config is treated as {}.
